node.statement: The fixed external witnesses satisfy e_env^0>0 and e_s2^0>0, so K_2^0=max{1,e_s2^0/e_env^0} is finite, universal, dimension-independent, and at least 1. If W.K2>=K_2^0 and 0<=epsilon<=W.e_s2/W.K2 with W.e_s2<=e_s2^0, then epsilon<=e_env^0 and 0<=t_2=W.K2*epsilon<=W.e_s2<=e_s2^0.
